name: Secret Customers
description: A curtain hides some sort boxes. Find and tap the Key box (golden scissors) to lift the curtain and reveal the hidden colors!
howToPlay: Fill the uncovered sort boxes first. When the curtained boxes reach the front of a column, tap the Key box on the grid to lift the curtain. The Key box has a golden scissors badge — look for it!
author: Claude

showcaseLevel.name: Secret Customers Demo
showcaseLevel.desc: Tap the Key box to lift the curtain
